learning.note: Matches correction_loop.escalation_threshold. After enough consistent corrections the pattern graduates to System 2 as complex_situation. This desk memory does not promote into System 1; that path is RL_OVERLAY only.
learning.life_safety_rule: Life-safety calls stay with System 2 until an operator presses Accept. Repeats are remembered, and the fast path does not take them on its own.

stream.how: The page plays scenarios[fixture_id].steps. To plug a real stream later, call BaanSafeSim.attachLiveFeed(source). source may be an EventSource or any object with addEventListener('step', ...). A future gateway path such as GET /cases/{case_id}/events (SSE) or a websocket can emit the same step objects with source set to gateway. Each simulated step keeps the simulated badge. A gateway step shows a gateway badge. The stub outcome is still rendered beside the sentence from POST /cases/{id}/turns.

event_fields.id: Stable step id inside the scenario.
event_fields.kind: memory | tool | system_1 | handoff | system_2 | sapling | router | operator_approval | dispatch
event_fields.delay_ms: How long to wait before revealing the next step. The page shortens this while Play 20 calls is running.
event_fields.source: simulated today. Use gateway when the object came from the live stream.
event_fields.when: Optional. rejected skips the step when System 1 is at or above the threshold. aid plays only when the stub route is aid_caseworker or a need is aid_payment. approved plays only after the operator presses Accept. operator_approval uses rejected, so it plays when the call is with System 2. dispatch uses approved, so it follows that Accept.
event_fields.fill: Optional. flood or shelter. The page fills the following line from flood.json / the drawn shelter path.
event_fields.verdict: Optional simulated Sapling label: supported, violation, missing, or unsure. Not a sapling_verdict from the gateway.

theme_fields.id: Stable pattern key. Similar fixtures share one id, so the second drinking-water call continues the first.
theme_fields.label: Plain English name shown in the pattern memory widget.
theme_fields.learns: False keeps the theme with System 2. Aid themes set this false. The fast path does not take them.
theme_fields.life_safety: True caps System 1 under the threshold until the operator presses Accept.
